method.population: SHORT rows reaching RRCE stage 3 with resolved/expired outcomes
method.episode_first: Keep the earliest replay observation for each symbol + sweep time + CHOCH break time + execution zone.
method.production_cadence_proxy: From episode-first entries, accept the first entry per symbol and suppress later entries for 4 hours, matching CONFIG signal_cooldown_hours.
method.candidate_thresholds: Frozen from the preceding event-aligned audit; no threshold tuning occurs here.

interpretation_rules: Row-level TP3 rates are not treated as independent evidence.
Episode-first is the primary structural unit for setup quality.
Cooldown-first is the closer replay proxy for production signal cadence.
A candidate is not approved by this audit, especially when the fresh window has fewer than 20 independent episodes.
Mixed outcomes remain visible; this audit does not convert any-TP3 into a trade success.
